entries.o: <fe><02><0a><33><37><33><61><5f><30><30><30><35><00>You mean it's from one of\nthose flying creatures?
<fe><02><0a><33><37><33><61><5f><30><30><31><31><00>I never guessed a demon\nwould be hiding there...
<fe><02><0a><33><37><33><62><5f><30><30><31><30><00>So we'll have to defeat\nthem to get by, right?
<fe><02><0a><33><38><33><61><5f><30><30><30><35><00>One of the Accursed! Demon,\nprepare to be sealed away!
<fe><02><0a><33><38><33><61><5f><30><30><31><36><00>We won't let you demons\nhave your way!
<fe><02><0a><33><38><33><63><5f><30><30><33><33><00>I feel icky... Let's finish\nthis and go home.
<fe><02><0a><33><38><34><63><5f><30><30><30><33><00>You know what we're going to\ndo first when we get back?

<fe><02><0a><33><38><34><63><5f><30><30><30><36><00>Well, whoever they were,
they respected nature.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><33><38><34><63><5f><30><30><30><37><00>This place was built deep
within the forest.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><33><38><34><63><5f><30><30><30><38><00>Plus, the traps they set
aren't harmful to nature.
<fe><02><0a><33><38><31><61><5f><30><30><32><33><00>I found the poor thing\ninjured in the forest.
<fe><02><0a><33><38><31><61><5f><30><30><32><35><00>Then I nursed my new\npartner back to health.

<fe><02><0a><33><38><31><61><5f><30><30><35><38><00>So whatcha gonna do now,
Cierra?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><33><38><31><61><5f><30><30><35><39><00>Won't it be hard for Gateau
to choose between you two?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><33><38><31><61><5f><30><30><36><30><00>I mean, a cat can't be in
two places at once...

<fe><02><0a><33><39><32><61><5f><30><30><30><33><00>It'd be really sad if we\nwere back at the entrance.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><33><39><32><61><5f><30><30><30><34><00>I don't think I could take\nit if that happened.
<fe><02><0a><33><39><32><61><5f><30><30><31><39><00>Yeah, it seems kinda\nsuspicious to me too.
<fe><02><0a><33><39><32><61><5f><30><30><32><35><00>Let's play it safe and\nkeep our distance.
<fe><02><0a><33><39><32><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>So it was a pretty\nimportant place, huh?
<fe><02><0a><33><39><32><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>The kings of Binon were\nlaid to rest here.
<fe><02><0a><33><39><33><62><5f><30><30><31><30><00>We should be worrying\nabout the enemy instead.
<fe><02><0a><33><39><33><62><5f><30><30><32><38><00>Are you gonna ask them\nwhere the crystal is?
<fe><02><0a><33><39><33><62><5f><30><30><33><39><00>You don't need to stress\nover some butterflies.
<fe><02><0a><33><39><33><62><5f><30><30><34><34><00>I can't catch a butterfly...\nHow lame is that?
<fe><02><0a><33><39><33><62><5f><30><30><36><35><00>It is time for me to awaken\nand you to sleep...
<fe><02><0a><33><39><34><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>There are steps ahead,\nso kids, be careful.

A forest located
south of Elendia.
The fertile land is
home to numerous
rare plants.

A massive tree grew
over ancient ruins,
eventually forming
a towering edifice.

A giant tree trunk
extends through
the ceiling, and
the floor has been 
weakened by rain.

Pelgas, dangerous
monster-like birds,
build nests such as
these in the branches
of trees.

A hollow area which
formed naturally as
the wood decayed.
The damp air inside
allows fungi to grow.

Platforms built with
timber from the tree
itself. Still sturdy
after hundreds of
years.

The remains of a wyrm
colony. In ancient
times, colonies like
this one were found
everywhere.

The highest level of
the ancient ruins.
The largest of all
wyrms reigned from
here.

Tomb of the royal
family of Binon.
It is hidden deep
within the forest
of Nelde.
<fe><02><0a><34><31><33><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>We have no choice but to\ndefeat them.
<fe><02><0a><34><31><33><62><5f><30><30><32><35><00>Gateau would've gotten it\nif you'd just asked.
<fe><02><0a><34><31><34><62><5f><30><30><31><35><00>We should get out as\nsoon as possible.
<fe><02><0a><34><32><32><62><5f><30><30><32><35><00>We should make sure we're\ndry before we continue.
<fe><02><09><65><30><38><5f><30><30><30><34><00>Fire magic sure comes in\nhandy in cases like this.
<fe><02><0a><34><32><33><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>We have no choice but to\ndefeat them.
<fe><02><0a><34><32><33><62><5f><30><30><31><35><00>Come to think of it,\nthere are ripples now...
<fe><02><0a><34><32><33><62><5f><30><30><31><36><00>The waters of Tetyth\nmay still be alive.
<fe><02><0a><34><32><33><62><5f><30><30><35><33><00>So, what are we gonna\ndo with the fish?
<fe><02><0a><34><32><33><62><5f><30><30><37><30><00>I guess I'm not cut out\nto be a fisherman...
<fe><02><0a><34><32><34><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>We might be at the\nentrance to Tetyth.
<fe><02><0a><34><32><31><61><5f><30><30><30><31><00>It's about time. Now we\ncan start our plan.
<fe><02><0a><34><33><31><63><5f><30><30><30><38><00>At this rate, the city\nwill be flooded soon...
<fe><02><0a><34><33><32><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>They won't let us\npass without a fight.
<fe><02><0a><34><33><33><61><5f><30><30><31><32><00>We should go before\nthe water catches up.
<fe><02><0a><34><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><31><00>How are we to search such\na small hole?
<fe><02><0a><34><33><33><63><5f><30><30><34><33><00>Looks like it'd be pretty\npainful if you fell here.
<fe><02><0a><34><33><33><63><5f><30><30><35><30><00>So the heaviest one has to\nstand on it, right?
<fe><02><0a><34><33><33><63><5f><30><30><35><36><00>Ein, who do ya think\nshould step on it?
<fe><02><0a><34><33><33><63><5f><30><30><35><39><00>(Just pick someone and be\ndone with it!)
<fe><02><0a><34><33><34><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>We needa hurry or\nthe water'll catch up!
<fe><02><0a><34><33><34><62><5f><30><30><31><32><00>We have no choice but\nto defeat them.
<fe><02><0a><34><33><34><62><5f><30><30><31><38><00>It seems like there are\nmany things here.

<fe><02><0a><34><34><31><63><5f><30><30><30><39><00>Even these buildings will\nwear away one day.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><34><34><31><63><5f><30><30><31><30><00>Did the architect even take\nthat into account?
<fe><02><0a><34><34><32><63><5f><30><30><34><39><00>I feel sorry for them,\nbut it's for our safety.
<fe><02><0a><34><34><33><63><5f><30><30><32><37><00>(Be careful, Ein. He's not\nas weak as he looks.)
<fe><02><0a><34><34><33><63><5f><30><30><33><38><00>If what he said is true,\nwe should hurry...
